tutorial.title: How to Play
tutorial.shortcuts: Shortcuts: R roll, B buy, E end turn, M manage. You can disable shortcuts in Settings.

turns.title: Take your turn
turns.body: Roll two dice, move your token, and follow the space instructions. Doubles earn another roll.

buying.title: Buy and collect rent
buying.body: Buy an unowned business or send it to auction. When another player lands on your asset, they pay rent.

building.title: Complete sets and build
building.body: Collect every business in a colour group to build houses evenly, then upgrade to a hotel.

jail.title: Time-Out Office
jail.body: Pay the fine, use a release card, or try for doubles. After three attempts, the fine is due.

trading.title: Make a trade
trading.body: Offer cash, assets, and release cards to other players. Both sides should agree before the trade goes through.

winning.title: Win the market
winning.body: Stay solvent while rivals go bankrupt. The last active player wins the game.

summary.title: Game summary
summary.chartLabel: Net worth over time by player
